practical_scenarios.title: Executive asks to skip discovery
practical_scenarios.situation: A sponsor has already promised a feature and says user research will only slow the launch.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Clarify the decision and risk, present existing evidence and gaps, propose the smallest time-boxed study or prototype test that can change the decision, document assumptions and agree explicit risk ownership if the team proceeds.

practical_scenarios.title: Participants praise the design but fail tasks
practical_scenarios.situation: Most participants say the prototype looks modern, yet only two of eight complete the primary task.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Prioritize observed task failure over stated preference, analyze where mental models and cues break, revise the flow and retest; retain the positive aesthetic feedback as a separate finding.

practical_scenarios.title: Brand palette fails accessibility
practical_scenarios.situation: The marketing team insists on a low-contrast brand color for body text and disabled states.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Show affected scenarios and standards, create accessible semantic alternatives that preserve brand in non-text roles, test with users and assistive technology, and escalate a documented compliance and inclusion risk if unresolved.

practical_scenarios.title: Mobile conversion collapses after redesign
practical_scenarios.situation: Desktop metrics improve but mobile users abandon after the address step.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Segment field and qualitative evidence, reproduce on real devices and slow networks, inspect reflow, keyboard, validation and autofill, correct the highest-impact issue and monitor guardrails after release.

practical_scenarios.title: Stakeholder requests another modal
practical_scenarios.situation: A team wants to place an announcement, mandatory survey and upgrade prompt in sequential modals at login.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Clarify user priority and urgency, identify interruption cost and accessibility risks, propose non-blocking or contextual alternatives, reserve modal behavior for decisions that genuinely require focused response and test the full sequence.

practical_scenarios.title: Team bypasses the design system
practical_scenarios.situation: A product team forks a shared component because the system release process feels slow.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Understand the unmet need and deadline, assess user and technical risk, agree a temporary namespaced implementation if necessary, create a contribution or migration path and improve system service levels using the incident evidence.

practical_scenarios.title: Developer says the design cannot be built
practical_scenarios.situation: Engineering identifies that an animated responsive interaction is too expensive for the current architecture.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Revisit the underlying user outcome, ask for constraints and alternatives, prototype simpler options, compare usability and technical cost and record the chosen trade-off rather than defending a specific animation.

practical_scenarios.title: Research sample excludes critical users
practical_scenarios.situation: A rapid study recruited only urban, English-speaking, high-end smartphone users for a national service.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: State what the evidence can and cannot support, identify excluded high-risk groups, adjust product claims and decisions, conduct targeted inclusive research and update recruitment operations to prevent recurrence.

practical_scenarios.title: Research findings conflict
practical_scenarios.situation: Interviews suggest users want detailed control, while usability tests show the controls cause confusion.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Check whether studies involved the same population and task, separate desired outcome from preferred implementation, inspect methodological limits, prototype progressive or expert modes and test behavior with relevant segments.

practical_scenarios.title: Localization breaks the layout
practical_scenarios.situation: German and Arabic versions cause clipped buttons, reversed icons and unreadable mixed-direction fields.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Treat this as a product-system defect, replace fixed sizing, test expansion and bidirectional behavior, review semantics with native specialists and add localized content states to component acceptance and visual regression tests.

practical_scenarios.title: Growth team proposes a dark pattern
practical_scenarios.situation: A manager asks to make cancellation difficult and visually weaken the decline option to improve retention.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Explain the autonomy, trust, legal and measurement risks, propose retention research and value improvements, design a clear reversible flow and document escalation if the request remains coercive.

practical_scenarios.title: AI-generated interface is confidently wrong
practical_scenarios.situation: An AI assistant creates plausible but incorrect financial guidance and users appear to trust it.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Reduce unsupported automation, communicate limits and provenance, add verification and correction paths, define high-risk deferral to humans, test overreliance and monitor harmful outcomes before expansion.

practical_scenarios.title: Motion causes discomfort
practical_scenarios.situation: Users report nausea and distraction from parallax, auto-rotating backgrounds and spring transitions.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Identify which motion conveys essential information, honor reduced-motion settings, replace depth and large-axis movement with stable alternatives, make animation interruptible and validate comfort and comprehension.

practical_scenarios.title: WebXR is unavailable on common devices
practical_scenarios.situation: A campaign concept depends on immersive WebXR, but analytics show many target users have unsupported browsers or no headset.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Treat XR as an enhancement, design a complete 2D fallback, communicate requirements before entry, test capability detection and preserve the core content and outcome across devices.

practical_scenarios.title: Creative experience performs poorly
practical_scenarios.situation: A generative landing page drops frames, delays input and consumes battery on mobile devices.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Profile rendering and interaction, reduce complexity and overdraw, use efficient animation properties, pause offscreen work, offer a static or reduced-motion experience and measure field performance after optimization.

practical_scenarios.title: Redesign has no baseline
practical_scenarios.situation: A team launches a complete redesign and asks design to prove that it is better afterward.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Reconstruct available baseline evidence, define outcome and guardrail metrics, run targeted usability comparison where feasible, avoid causal claims unsupported by data and establish measurement before future major changes.

practical_scenarios.title: Senior leader prefers a different design
practical_scenarios.situation: A leader chooses an option based on personal taste despite research and accessibility evidence supporting another.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Restate the decision criteria and user impact, show evidence and uncertainty succinctly, explore whether a hidden business constraint exists, record the decision and escalate material accessibility or ethical risk through governance.

practical_scenarios.title: Portfolio work is confidential
practical_scenarios.situation: A candidate’s strongest project is under NDA and includes sensitive user and commercial information.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Create a sanitized case study that focuses on the class of problem, role, process and learning, replace data with ranges or synthetic examples, obtain permission where required and be explicit about omitted details and team contribution.

Uses hierarchy, typography, color, spacing, tokens and components coherently across content, themes and platforms.

Collaborates effectively with engineering, understands responsive implementation, performance, component testing and creative APIs.
